requirements.cross_season_identity: A persistent biological ID/recapture mapping across seasons, or a justified single-season sampling design with verified nest units.
requirements.nest_crosswalk: An authoritative nest identifier for every retained capture, its scope across species/islands/seasons, and a prespecified handling rule for paired adults.
requirements.persistent_identity: A source-authoritative capture-to-persistent-bird crosswalk and recapture history, or a documented independently sampled replacement cohort.
requirements.specimen_reference_independence: Specimen-linked independent genetic/voucher identification with provenance, adjudication rules, ambiguity and missing-label accounting; define the validation estimand before fitting.
requirements.upstream_equivalence: Retrieve the exact cited archive entities and verify checksums, version provenance and any row/value differences before claiming upstream equivalence.

review_boundary: Hashes bind snapshots and declarations; reviewed prose is not machine-certified biological truth
